# connectracer_connect_data_table_record (Resource)

A record of an Amazon Connect data table: its primary values and the values of its other attributes.

Attributes are addressed by name. Every write sends the lock version Connect currently holds for each value, read right before the write, and writes all values of the record in one call. A value changed outside Terraform is therefore overwritten on the next apply rather than failing it.

A record whose primary values exist already is taken over on create rather than refused. A write that conflicts with another one, e.g. from a parallel apply, is retried with the record read again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The closed message of a support line: a table keyed by hours and override, with an
# active flag and the text a flow plays while closed.
resource "connectracer_connect_data_table_record" "support_closed" {
  instance_id   = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  data_table_id = "abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"

  primary_values = {
    hours    = "support"
    override = "*"
  }

  values = {
    active  = "true"
    message = "We are closed right now. Please call again during our opening hours."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_table_id` (String) The identifier of the data table.
- `instance_id` (String) The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.
- `primary_values` (Map of String) The value of every primary attribute, keyed by attribute name. Other primary values make another record, so a change replaces it.
- `values` (Map of String) The values of the other attributes, keyed by attribute name, as text whatever the attribute's type (`"true"` for a boolean). Attributes left out are not touched.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite identifier (`instance_id/data_table_id/record_id`).
- `record_id` (String) The identifier of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is instance_id/data_table_id/record_id.
terraform import connectracer_connect_data_table_record.support_closed \
  "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012/abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890/fedcba98-7654-3210-fedc-ba9876543210"
```
